scope: Language, tool telemetry, Admin operations, CMS and support; synthetic local data only
postgres: PostgreSQL 17.6 on x86_64-apple-darwin23.6.0, compiled by Apple clang version 16.0.0 (clang-1600.0.26.6), 64-bit

checks.name: additive migrations apply/reapply without changing existing users or another application
service_role CAS update persists and same request replays without a new revision
stale requests conflict rather than overriding explicit language
concurrent changes at the same revision allow exactly one winner
other account is isolated and invalid input cannot mutate stored choices
real attached UI stages persist once and retain the first observation
foreign account, unrelated card and invented payment success cannot be acknowledged
RLS and direct RPC grants reject anon/authenticated even with forged owner/service claims
safe rollback revokes new callers without deleting data; reapply restores access
admin overview is server aggregated, unknown costs remain null and private user content is excluded
completed and failed user requests differ from provider calls; paid Stars exclude failures and non-XTR payments
admin pagination and literal search do not leak a full directory, invalid filters fail closed
no role is assigned automatically and database clients cannot invoke admin aggregates
wallet retries execute exactly once across eight concurrent requests
wallet concurrent confirmations cannot overwrite another adjustment or make a negative balance
independent grants revoke/restore without touching paid or Lifetime rights
CMS saves immutable versions, rejects stale edits and publishes into the existing catalog
CMS invalid publication rolls back both catalog and version history atomically
support lifecycle, private notes and concurrent revision protection preserve existing ticket API
audit and versions cannot be rewritten by the service caller; direct clients have no grants
operation rollback gate preserves data and reapplication restores only its scoped RPC
operational analytics aggregate real statuses, not private messages or invented missing referral data
quota bonuses cannot bypass the closed global budget and do not disappear on denied calls
two provider calls in one operation hold one quota bonus; duplicate attempts and foreign leases do not consume another
failed answers release only their own bonus, while history and provider-cost reservations remain intact
success consumes one bonus; revoking unused allowance never restores consumed answers
explicit role changes are audited and cannot manufacture the configured owner role
grant extension uses expected expiry and preserves the paid fallback source
extra quota tables and RPCs deny direct client access even with forged role claims
